robotTypes.name: Quadcopter
robotTypes.tagline: 4-rotor aerial platform — the standard for aerial robotics.
robotTypes.description: Quadcopters are the most common multirotor configuration. Four independent rotors provide stable hover, agile maneuvering, and payload capacity from grams to kilograms. Used for inspection, surveying, cinematography, delivery, and research.

hardwareModels.name: DJI Matrice 300 RTK
hardwareModels.desc: Enterprise flagship with 55-min flight, IP45 rating, and multi-payload support. 15 km transmission range.

hardwareModels.name: DJI Mavic 3 Enterprise
hardwareModels.desc: Compact enterprise drone with mechanical shutter, RTK module, and 45-min flight. Ideal for mapping and inspection.

hardwareModels.name: PX4 Custom Quad
hardwareModels.desc: Fully open-source PX4/ArduPilot quadcopter. Build your own frame, stack companion computer (RPi/Jetson), and run ROS 2 on board.

hardwareModels.name: Skydio X10
hardwareModels.desc: AI-powered autonomous drone with 360° obstacle avoidance, FLIR thermal, and 40-min flight. Best-in-class autonomous navigation.

robotTypes.name: Hexacopter
robotTypes.tagline: 6-rotor heavy-lift platform — redundancy and payload.
robotTypes.description: Six rotors provide motor-out redundancy and higher payload capacity. Used for heavy-lift cinematography, LiDAR surveying, agricultural spraying, and industrial cargo.

hardwareModels.name: DJI Agras T40
hardwareModels.desc: Agricultural spraying drone with 40 kg payload, 50 L tank, dual radar, and terrain-following. Covers 21 ha/hr.

hardwareModels.name: Freefly Alta X
hardwareModels.desc: Heavy-lift cinema hexacopter with 16 kg payload, folding arms, and open-source PX4 autopilot.

robotTypes.name: Fixed-Wing UAV
robotTypes.tagline: Long-endurance fixed-wing for mapping and surveying vast areas.
robotTypes.description: Fixed-wing UAVs offer flight times of 1-4+ hours, covering hundreds of square kilometers per flight. Used for aerial surveying, agriculture monitoring, pipeline inspection, and defense.

hardwareModels.name: WingtraOne Gen II
hardwareModels.desc: VTOL fixed-wing survey drone. Takes off and lands vertically, flies like a plane. 54-min endurance, 42 MP Sony RX1R II camera.

hardwareModels.name: senseFly eBee X
hardwareModels.desc: Fixed-wing mapping drone with swappable payloads (RGB, multispectral, thermal). Covers 500 ha/flight.

robotTypes.name: Differential Drive
robotTypes.tagline: Two-wheel differential base — the classic mobile robot.
robotTypes.description: The simplest and most common wheeled robot configuration. Two independently driven wheels plus a caster for balance. Used in education, research, warehouse logistics, and indoor service robots.

hardwareModels.name: TurtleBot 4
hardwareModels.desc: The standard ROS 2 education/research platform. iRobot Create 3 base, RPi 4, OAK-D camera, 2-D LiDAR. Runs ROS 2 Humble/Jazzy.

hardwareModels.name: TurtleBot 3 Burger / Waffle
hardwareModels.desc: Compact, affordable ROS platform. Burger has 360° LiDAR; Waffle adds an Intel RealSense camera.

hardwareModels.name: Clearpath Dingo
hardwareModels.desc: Indoor research robot for manipulation. Modular payload mounts, 5/12 V power rails, ROS 2-native.

robotTypes.name: Mecanum Wheel
robotTypes.tagline: Omnidirectional mecanum base — full holonomic motion.
robotTypes.description: Four mecanum rollers enable strafing, rotation, and diagonal motion — full 3-DOF planar movement. Used in tight-space logistics, mobile manipulation, and any application needing omnidirectional capability.

hardwareModels.name: OmniBot Pro (Reference)
hardwareModels.desc: OhhO's reference mecanum mobile manipulator. Yahboom X3 base, SO-101 6-DOF arm, Pi 5 brain, full ROS 2 stack. The platform the entire OhhO suite is built on.

hardwareModels.name: Yahboom Rosmaster X3
hardwareModels.desc: Popular mecanum ROS robot kit. 4 STS servos, encoder odometry, IMU. Add your own SBC and sensors.

hardwareModels.name: Nexus 4WD Mecanum
hardwareModels.desc: Heavy-duty mecanum base with 100 mm wheels, BLDC motors, and IP54 rating for light outdoor use.

robotTypes.name: Ackermann Steering
robotTypes.tagline: Car-like steering — for outdoor autonomy and delivery.
robotTypes.description: Car-like steering geometry for outdoor, higher-speed applications. Used in autonomous delivery, agriculture, and outdoor logistics where mecanum or differential bases are limited.

hardwareModels.name: Clearpath Husky A300
hardwareModels.desc: Rugged outdoor UGV with Ackermann steering. IP65, 75 kg payload, 20 km range. ROS 2-native with full sensor integration.

hardwareModels.name: MIT Racecar/J
hardwareModels.desc: Open-source 1/10 scale autonomous vehicle platform. NVIDIA Jetson + VESC motor controller. Used in F1Tenth racing.

robotTypes.name: Quadruped (Dog)
robotTypes.tagline: Four-legged robots — walk, climb, and navigate complex terrain.
robotTypes.description: Quadruped robots traverse stairs, gravel, grass, and rubble that wheeled robots cannot. Used for inspection, security, construction monitoring, and research on dynamic locomotion.

hardwareModels.name: Unitree Go2
hardwareModels.desc: The most popular quadruped. 12-DOF, 8 kg payload, 5 m/s top speed, 4-D LiDAR. ROS 2 SDK with full walking/trotting gaits.

hardwareModels.name: Unitree B2
hardwareModels.desc: High-performance quadruped. 6 m/s, 20 kg payload, 2 hr runtime, IP67 rating. Industrial inspection and security.

hardwareModels.name: Boston Dynamics Spot
hardwareModels.desc: The industrial-standard quadruped. Dynamic sensing, autonomous navigation, dock charging, and a rich payload ecosystem. API + SDK for custom autonomy.

hardwareModels.name: ANYmal D
hardwareModels.desc: Swiss-engineered quadruped for industrial inspection. Full autonomy with 360° perception, stair climbing, and ATEX certification option.

robotTypes.name: Hexapod
robotTypes.tagline: Six-legged robots — extreme stability and payload.
robotTypes.description: Six legs provide static stability — the robot can walk while keeping 3+ feet on the ground. Used for heavy-duty inspection, search and rescue, and terrain that defeats even quadrupeds.

hardwareModels.name: PhantomX AX Hexapod
hardwareModels.desc: Open-source 18-DOF hexapod. Dynamixel AX-12A servos, ROS-compatible. Research platform for gait generation and terrain adaptation.

robotTypes.name: Full Humanoid
robotTypes.tagline: Bipedal humanoid robots — the frontier of embodied AI.
robotTypes.description: Full-scale humanoid robots with two legs, two arms, and dexterous hands. The ultimate platform for general-purpose embodied AI — manipulation, navigation, and human-robot interaction in human-designed environments.

hardwareModels.name: Unitree H1
hardwareModels.desc: General-purpose humanoid. 51-DOF, 19-DOF dexterous hands, 5 km/h walking, 3-D LiDAR + depth cameras. Open SDK.

hardwareModels.name: Unitree G1
hardwareModels.desc: Compact humanoid. 23-43 DOF, 3-finger dexterous hands, 14 cm depth camera. Targeted at home and service use.

hardwareModels.name: Figure 02
hardwareModels.desc: Electric humanoid with human-scale dexterity. Built for industrial work — 16-DOF hands, 2.5-hr runtime, integrated AI with speech.

hardwareModels.name: Fourier GR-2
hardwareModels.desc: Humanoid with 53-DOF, 12-DOF dexterous hands with tactile sensing. 1.75 m tall, 63 kg, designed for healthcare and service.

robotTypes.name: Tracked UGV
robotTypes.tagline: Tank-tread ground vehicles — conquer any terrain.
robotTypes.description: Tracked platforms for rough terrain, stairs, mud, and snow. Higher traction and lower ground pressure than wheeled robots. Used for military, search and rescue, mining, and heavy outdoor logistics.

hardwareModels.name: Clearpath Warthog
hardwareModels.desc: Heavy-duty amphibious tracked UGV. 272 kg payload, 18 kW drivetrain, IP65. Built for mining, agriculture, and defense.

hardwareModels.name: Clearpath Jackal
hardwareModels.desc: Compact, weatherproof tracked UGV. 20 kg payload, IP62. ROS 2-native. Used for field robotics research.

robotTypes.name: Autonomous Surface Vessel
robotTypes.tagline: Unmanned surface vessels for ocean and inland water operations.
robotTypes.description: Autonomous boats for hydrographic surveying, environmental monitoring, bathymetry, and maritime security. Operate on lakes, rivers, harbors, and coastal waters.

hardwareModels.name: Clearpath Heron
hardwareModels.desc: ASV for bathymetric and environmental survey. Differential thrust, 3-hr endurance, payload bay with plug-and-play sensors.

robotTypes.name: Collaborative Robot Arm
robotTypes.tagline: Cobots — safe, teachable robot arms for manufacturing and labs.
robotTypes.description: Collaborative robots (cobots) are designed to work alongside humans without safety cages. Used for pick-and-place, assembly, quality inspection, lab automation, and CNC tending.

hardwareModels.name: Universal Robots UR5e
hardwareModels.desc: 6-DOF cobot. 5 kg payload, 850 mm reach, ±0.03 mm repeatability. ROS 2 driver via ur_robot_driver. The industry-standard cobot.

hardwareModels.name: Universal Robots UR10e
hardwareModels.desc: Heavy-payload cobot. 12.5 kg payload, 1300 mm reach. ROS 2 driver available. Ideal for palletizing and machine tending.

hardwareModels.name: Franka Research 3
hardwareModels.desc: 7-DOF torque-controlled research arm. 3 kg payload, 855 mm reach, joint torque sensing. Gold-standard for manipulation research.

hardwareModels.name: Kinova Gen3
hardwareModels.desc: 6 or 7-DOF lightweight arm. 4 kg payload, 902 mm reach. Full ROS 2 support, open architecture. Designed for research and assistive tech.

hardwareModels.name: Dobot CR10
hardwareModels.desc: 6-DOF cobot. 10 kg payload, 1525 mm reach. Cost-effective alternative for education, light industry, and robotics labs.

hardwareModels.name: SO-101 (LeRobot 6-DOF)
hardwareModels.desc: Open-source 3D-printed 6-DOF arm with Feetech STS3215 servos. 0.62 m reach, 0.5 kg payload. Designed for imitation-learning research.

robotTypes.name: Delta Robot
robotTypes.tagline: High-speed parallel robot for pick-and-place and sorting.
robotTypes.description: Delta robots use three parallelograms for extreme speed in lightweight pick-and-place. Used in food packaging, pharmaceutical sorting, and electronics assembly.

hardwareModels.name: ABB IRB 360 FlexPicker
hardwareModels.desc: Industry-standard delta robot. 1-8 kg payload, up to 200 picks/min. Hygienic design for food handling.

robotTypes.name: Full Mobile Manipulator
robotTypes.tagline: Wheels + arm — the complete embodied-AI platform.
robotTypes.description: A mobile base with a mounted manipulator arm. These are the fully-capable robots — they navigate to a location, then use the arm to interact with the world. The reference platform for embodied AI research and deployment.

hardwareModels.name: OmniBot Pro (Reference)
hardwareModels.desc: Yahboom X3 mecanum base + SO-101 6-DOF arm. RPi 5 brain, depth + wrist cameras, full ROS 2 + VLA stack. The complete reference platform.

hardwareModels.name: Hello Robot Stretch RE2
hardwareModels.desc: Low-cost mobile manipulator for home/office research. Telescoping arm, compliant gripper, Intel RealSense, ROS 2-native.

hardwareModels.name: Fetch Mobile Manipulator
hardwareModels.desc: Warehouse mobile manipulator. Differential base + 7-DOF arm, 150 kg payload on base, 6 kg on arm. Designed for logistics AMR research.

hardwareModels.name: AgileX Tracer + Arm
hardwareModels.desc: Mini differential base with optional 4/6-DOF arm. ROS 2 drivers, modular payload, compact for labs and classrooms.

robotTypes.name: Small Swarm Robot
robotTypes.tagline: Tiny robots that collaborate — collective intelligence at scale.
robotTypes.description: Small, inexpensive robots that work together as a collective. Used for warehouse inventory, search and rescue, educational robotics, and research on emergent behavior and distributed algorithms.

hardwareModels.name: Khepera IV
hardwareModels.desc: Classic swarm research robot. 2 wheels, 12 IR sensors, camera, Linux onboard. ROS-compatible. Used in hundreds of swarm research papers.

hardwareModels.name: E-Puck2
hardwareModels.desc: Desktop swarm robot. Differential drive, 8 IR proximity, ToF sensor, microphone, speaker, WiFi. Huge open-source ecosystem.

robotTypes.name: Precision Agriculture
robotTypes.tagline: Farming robots — plant, monitor, weed, and harvest autonomously.
robotTypes.description: Autonomous platforms for precision agriculture — targeted weeding, selective harvesting, soil analysis, and crop monitoring. Reduce chemical use and labor costs through robotic precision.

hardwareModels.name: FarmBot Genesis
hardwareModels.desc: Open-source CNC farming robot. Cartesian gantry plants, waters, and weeds a garden bed. Fully open hardware + software.

hardwareModels.name: ecoRobotix AVO
hardwareModels.desc: Autonomous weeding robot. Solar-powered, vision-based precision spraying. Treats only weeds, reducing herbicide by 90%.

robotTypes.name: Inspection ROV
robotTypes.tagline: Subsea robots — inspect, maintain, and explore underwater.
robotTypes.description: Remotely operated underwater vehicles for dam inspection, hull cleaning, aquaculture monitoring, pipeline survey, and marine research. Depth ratings from 100 m to 6,000 m.

hardwareModels.name: BlueROV2
hardwareModels.desc: Open-source ROV. 6 thrusters, HD camera, 100 m depth rating. Full ROS 2 integration via ArduSub. The standard for affordable underwater robotics.

hardwareModels.name: BlueROV2 Heavy
hardwareModels.desc: Heavy-configuration ROV with 8 T200 thrusters, gripper, scanning sonar, and 300 m depth rating for inspection missions.

robotTypes.name: Planetary Rover
robotTypes.tagline: Exploring other worlds — robotic rovers for planetary science.
robotTypes.description: Autonomous rovers for planetary exploration, lunar construction, and orbital servicing. Designed for extreme environments with radiation hardening, thermal management, and multi-year autonomy.

hardwareModels.name: ExoMy Rover
hardwareModels.desc: 3D-printed Mars rover replica by ESA. 6 wheels with rocker-bogie suspension, RPi compute, stereo cameras. Educational + research platform.

hardwareModels.name: JPL Open Source Rover
hardwareModels.desc: NASA JPL's open-source 6-wheel rover design. Rocker-bogie suspension, corner steering. Used for education and outreach.

robotTypes.name: Surgical Robot
robotTypes.tagline: Precision surgical platforms — teleoperated and autonomous.
robotTypes.description: Robotic surgical systems that extend the surgeon's capabilities — tremor filtering, motion scaling, and 3-D HD visualization. Used across urology, gynecology, orthopedics, and general surgery.

hardwareModels.name: da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK)
hardwareModels.desc: Open-source research platform based on the da Vinci Surgical System. ROS-based control, stereo endoscope, 7-DOF manipulators. Used in 100+ research labs worldwide.

robotTypes.name: Rehabilitation Robot
robotTypes.tagline: Assistive robotics — exoskeletons and therapy platforms.
robotTypes.description: Robots for physical rehabilitation, mobility assistance, and prosthetics. Used in post-stroke gait training, spinal cord injury recovery, and powered exoskeleton mobility.

hardwareModels.name: MyoPro Orthosis
hardwareModels.desc: Powered arm orthosis that reads surface EMG signals to assist arm movement. FDA-cleared for stroke, SCI, and neuromuscular conditions.

robotTypes.name: Sidewalk Delivery
robotTypes.tagline: Last-mile autonomous delivery — sidewalks and pedestrian zones.
robotTypes.description: Compact, sidewalk-navigating delivery robots for food, groceries, and parcels. Speed-limited for pedestrian safety, with curb-dropping capability and remote human oversight.

hardwareModels.name: Starship Delivery Robot
hardwareModels.desc: The most deployed autonomous delivery robot. 6 wheels, curb-climbing, insulated cargo hold. Millions of commercial deliveries completed.

hardwareModels.name: Coco Delivery Robot
hardwareModels.desc: Compact pink sidewalk delivery robot. Emphasizes safe pedestrian interaction with expressive displays and remote-assist capability.

robotTypes.name: Pipeline Inspection
robotTypes.tagline: Confined-space inspection — pipes, tanks, and infrastructure.
robotTypes.description: Robots designed to crawl inside pipes, ducts, tanks, and confined spaces for inspection and maintenance. Used in oil & gas, water utilities, HVAC, and nuclear decommissioning.

hardwareModels.name: Inyodrive Pipe Crawler
hardwareModels.desc: Modular pipe inspection robot. Tracks or magnetic wheels, PTZ camera, gas sensors. Customizable diameter and length for different pipe sizes.

hardwareModels.name: Flyability Elios 3
hardwareModels.desc: Caged indoor inspection drone. Collision-tolerant protective cage, 4K PTZ camera, LiDAR payload, SLAM-based stabilization. For confined-space inspection without human entry.
